facts.value: An eight-byte .sdata2 literal pool holding big-endian f32 0.0F then 1.0F, bytes 000000003f800000 in both existing objects. Split-object flags are SHF_ALLOC; source-object flags are SHF_ALLOC|SHF_WRITE. The reviewed entry code loads these values without writing the pool.
facts.rationale: Separate load-only literal use from different split/source ELF permissions.

evidence.why: A press, inclusive Y and strict angle tests; item override; local entry state writes.
Stick angle uses atan2(Y, abs(X)), not facing.
A press plus shoulder/item-specific throw eligibility.
Supplied LightThrowHi state enters with throw initialization.
AttackHi3 move identifier and active callback row.

facts.value: Supplies the zero and one floating-point literals used to initialize AttackHi3 animation frame, blend and playback speed. It is a literal pool rather than a gameplay table. Entry only loads the pool; source-object section flags include WRITE while split-object flags do not.
facts.rationale: Qualify read-only wording using both existing object sections.
